executive_assessment.text: NDC reports about 1.4°C warming since 1970; rainy seasons shortened and intensified, especially in north and west.
The modeled yield functions show crop-specific responses; although wetter conditions often yield net gains, the appendix identifies drier conditions as Rwanda's greatest crop risk.

geographic_notes.text: Rwanda; Northern Province; Western Province: NDC reports about 1.4°C warming since 1970; rainy seasons shortened and intensified, especially in north and west.
Rwanda; Nile-Congo divide: Heavy rain triggered May 2023 floods and landslides, causing 131 deaths and over 110 injuries along the Nile-Congo divide.
East Africa; Rwanda: A cited study says 2024 East African rains/floods were twice as likely and 5% more intense due to human climate influence.
Nyagatare; Kayonza; Kirehe; Bugesera: NDC identifies Nyagatare, Kayonza, Kirehe and Bugesera as dry lowlands with frequent rainfall deficits.
